items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: I believe I'll go to Al J and get me some graveyard.

ctx.x: That comes from the Indian, you know, to a witch doctor. And they had another one you used to call the witch here. Used to have the picture of the old witch riding the broom. And black cat and all like that. That's why I named my piece like that. I got it in my name and the black cat on the fence. They say the old witch riding the broom. See on Halloween night, they have the paper cuttings, you know, the witch riding the broom, the black cat, round by a graveyard or something like that. Used to say that over the…
I said, what you going to do?
